svg.text: Car2 / CAN network and controller wiring
Physical cable order supplied by user: acceleration -> master -> steering -> brake
LOGIC VIN SUPPLY [?] - 5 V expected; verify buck output [Q03]
COMMON LOGIC GND [R] - reference for all four CAN modules / Teensys; verify continuity [Q03]
Two 120-ohm resistors only: acceleration end and brake end. Count module jumpers. Expect about 60 ohms H-L with ALL power
and USB off. Earlier reported measurement: about 30 ohms.
Brake CAN module is still on H/L [U], so it remains the cable end. Its terminator still counts with the Teensy unplugged. If the
entire brake cable is removed, steering becomes the new terminated end.
Basis: calebhylkema/car2_ws pin map + current session reports/tests. Reference repo does not override these pins.
Review draft: [?] details are incomplete. Diagram colors do not specify vehicle wire colors. Junction dots indicate connections.
